item.title: Crimson Moonblade — Chapter 10: The Mark in the Metal
item.description: Under a moon that bleeds every hundred years, the exiled swordsman Akane Shiro carries a blade that drinks memory instead of blood. Each cut erases a piece of who he was — and the shrine-lords who exiled him are counting on him forgetting why.

item.title: Sakura Oathkeeper — Chapter 11: A Promise Without a Seal
item.description: Sworn to guard a sky-castle that only appears at sunrise, Yuki Shirogane has kept her oath for three hundred dawns. When a stranger climbs the waterfall stair carrying her own lost sword, the oath begins to unravel petal by petal.

item.title: Neon Kitsune — Chapter 7: The Bridge Off the Map
item.description: Neo-Kyoto, 2189. A fox spirit trapped inside a city-wide AI starts leaving riddles in traffic lights. Hacker-courier Sora is the only one who can read them — and every answer gets someone erased from the grid.

item.title: The Last Table — Chapter 2: Twelve Before Noon
item.description: When 24-year-old Hana Mori inherits her grandmother’s tiny railway-station diner, she arrives with a grand menu and very little practice. A teasing station attendant, a hungry bicycle courier, and a notebook of family recipes help her discover what keeps a diner alive: one good plate and a reason to come back tomorrow.
